findings.summary: New. The map's own behaviour is map::show's, not GMapControl's. (a) Right-drag panning, which is GMap's DragButton with CanDragMap = true, is missing, because map::show pans only on a primary drag. (b) Alt+left-drag: C# sets no isMouseDown and GMap does not drag on Left, so nothing moves. In the port, consume = isMouseDown is false, so map::show pans. (c) map_MouseDown tests !alt, where C# tests ModifierKeys != Keys.Alt exactly. Alt+Shift counts as a normal press in C#. (d) map_MouseMove uses primary_down, where C# requires e.Button == Left exactly (Left+Right held does not drag). (e) Wheel zoom is smooth and fractional (scroll/200) and clamped at provider max + 2, not integer steps around the cursor up to MaxZoom 24. (f) Marker enter/leave runs during a right-drag, where C# skips it while Core.mouseDown is set. (g) The empty-grid return leaves map.HoldInvalidation = true in C#, so the map stops repainting until the next non-empty grid. The port keeps painting. (h) MouseUp fires whenever the release is over the map, ignoring which control captured the press.
findings.required_fix: Give map::show a GMapControl mode: a configurable DragButton (Right here), integer wheel zoom at the mouse position bounded by MinZoom/MaxZoom, and no primary pan when the host handles the mouse. Use exact modifier and button equality in the handlers, skip enter/leave while a drag-button press is active, model HoldInvalidation (freeze the last frame), and track press capture for MouseUp.

findings.cs_reference: .NET Framework decimal.cpp VarDecFromR8 / VarR8FromDec; Number.ParseDecimal with NumberStyles.Number; Decimal.ToString() (NumberFormatInfo.NegativeSign)
findings.summary: New. The System.Decimal helpers are approximations and have no tests. (1) decimal_from_double formats {:.14e} and calls Decimal::from_scientific. For |x| < ~1e-14 this needs a scale above 28, from_scientific fails, and unwrap_or returns 0. VarDecFromR8 caps the scale at 28 and keeps the digits, so (decimal)1e-15 = 0.000000000000001. It also rounds the exact decimal expansion half-to-even, where VarDecFromR8 scales with dbl * 10^p in double arithmetic and rounds the residual (> 0.5, or == 0.5 with an odd mantissa), so the 15th digit can differ. (2) decimal_to_double uses rust_decimal's as_f64: integral + frac, then round(value * 10^s) / 10^s. VarR8FromDec computes ((double)lo64 + (double)hi32 * 2^64) / 10^scale. The two agree for mantissas below about 2^52 and diverge above that, for example a parsed 20-digit value. (3) decimal_parse maps overflow to FormatException ('Input string was not in a correct format.') where C# throws OverflowException ('Value was either too large or too small for a Decimal.'). It rejects a trailing sign ('5-'), which NumberStyles.Number allows. (4) decimal_to_string replaces only '.' and ignores the culture's NegativeSign.
findings.required_fix: Port VarDecFromR8 and VarR8FromDec bit for bit on the 96-bit mantissa and scale. Make decimal_parse follow ParseNumber for NumberStyles.Number: trailing sign, overflow as OverflowException, more than 28 digits rounded. Use NegativeSign. Add golden tests: (decimal)1e-15, (decimal)0.1, (decimal)123.456789012345678, (double)79228162514264337593543950335m, decimal.Parse('5-'), '1,000.50', and 'F2'/'0.##' of 2.345m and -0.001m.

findings.cs_reference: SimpleGridUI.cs:421-451 (quickadd, AddWPtoList..., quickadd = false, writeKML(), savesettings(), Close()), 228 (list[i] = ..., List<T> indexer), 464-467; GMapControl.cs:918-923 (lazyEvents), RectLatLng.LocationRightBottom; SimpleGridPlugin.cs:69 (ApplyThemeTo before ShowDialog/Load)
findings.summary: New. These are order and exception-path details. (1) savesettings runs before the AddWPtoList calls. In C# it runs after them and after writeKML, so an exception in AddCommand leaves the settings unsaved. (2) GridUI_Load runs inside new(), before the caller's equivalent of ThemeManager.ApplyThemeTo. (3) ZoomAndCenterMarkers passes the raw bottom/right to FromLatLngToPixel. C# uses rect.LocationRightBottom = (top - (top - bottom), left + (right - left)), which can differ in the last bit. It also applies at once where C# defers through lazyEvents until the control loads. (4) map_MouseMove returns IndexOutOfRange ('Index was outside the bounds of the array.') for a bad CurrentGMapMarkerIndex. List<T>'s indexer setter throws ArgumentOutOfRange ('Index was out of range. Must be non-negative and less than the size of the collection.\r\nParameter name: index'). (5) map.HoldInvalidation true/false around the rebuild is not modelled (see R71-04 g).
findings.required_fix: Move savesettings after the adds (return it as part of the Accept result, applied after add_wp_to_list and writeKML). Run Load after theming, in the frame the window first shows. Compute LocationRightBottom as C# does. Use the List indexer exception.

findings.cs_reference: ExtLibs/Utilities/CircularBuffer.cs:150-163 (Get(T[],..) can leave head == capacity), 133-141 (Skip leaves head >= capacity when count > capacity), 166-178 (Get(): var item = buffer[head] throws IndexOutOfRangeException)
findings.summary: New, the other half of this round's Put(T) fix. get_range leaves head == capacity after reading the last slot, and skip(count) can leave head >= capacity. C#'s Get() then reads buffer[head] and throws IndexOutOfRangeException, while the port indexes self.buffer[self.head as usize] and panics. Repro: cap 3, put_all([1,2,3]), get_count(3), put_all([4]) (tail wraps, size 1), get(). C# throws IndexOutOfRange, the port panics.

verdict: The build is clean and all 417 tests pass, verified by running them, which rounds 68-70 could not do. The four compile fixes match the C#. ExtLibs/SimpleGrid is a real file-by-file port: the resx layout is exact to the pixel, the constructor and Load order matches (including the DataSource-triggered empty run), NumericUpDown keeps its decimal semantics, and domainUpDown1_ValueChanged, calcpolygonarea (including the FPDrawnPolygon mutation), getAngleOfLongestSide, ZoomAndCenterMarkers and BUT_Accept_Click follow the C# statement by statement. The plugin's but_Click is wired into Auto WP. That fixes R70-03 and lifts ported lines to 34,792 / 479,014 (7.3%). The cap stays at 1.8 because ceil1(0.726) is still 0.8. Against an exact clone, the form still falls short in ways a user would notice. It is modeless and fixed-size where C# is a modal, Sizable ShowDialog. Its map pans and zooms the app's way instead of GMapControl's. Its tooltips and the shared yellow DefaultStroke are wrong. Its error boxes lose the 'Error' caption. The accept path goes through a shim of the unported FlightPlanner.setfromMap without the home-alt and default-alt prompts. The new System.Decimal helpers approximate VarDecFromR8/VarR8FromDec and have no tests. Clippy fails on three deny lints. MANIFEST.md is stale for seven ported files. GridUI (R71-02) still uses heuristics, and about 92.7% of owned C# is unported. Awarded 1.5 of a 1.8 cap. Round-file fidelity 6.6, UI/UX 2.7, features 3.6.
